# Blue Flame Games (BFG) — full reference

> Privacy-first iPhone, iPad and Mac apps and games by Blue Flame Games, across finance, education, health, fitness, travel, weather, music, kids and games. No third-party ads, no tracking-first business model. Your data stays on your device wherever the product allows.

Last updated: 2026-11-12. Short index: https://bfgapps.co/llms.txt. Machine-readable catalogue: https://bfgapps.co/apps.json

## Company

- Name: Blue Flame Games (short name BFG)
- Website: https://bfgapps.co/
- App Store developer page: https://apps.apple.com/developer/blue-flame-games/id523824138
- Contact: blueflamegames@proton.me
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad; some apps also run on Mac and Apple Watch. No Android versions.
- Website languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Simplified Chinese.

## Apps

### Tickview: SEC Filings & Alerts

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/kanesh/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760582379
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad
- Category: Finance
- Price: 7-day Pro trial, then a one-time purchase or a monthly subscription
- Privacy: No account, no ads. All AI runs on the device; the app fetches only public market data.
- Privacy policy: https://bfgapps.co/apps/kanesh/privacy.html; support: https://bfgapps.co/apps/kanesh/support.html

Sourced alerts for your watchlist and the economy: new SEC filings, insider purchases, price crossings and Recession Watch (a model probability shown with its track record), plus the bond market and plain-English questions answered with sourced cards. Not investment advice.

Who it is for: Individual investors who want sourced information on iPhone and iPad rather than tips.

**Can I verify the data myself?**

Yes. Result cards name their source, link to it and show the date of their data, and filings open on SEC EDGAR. Tickview presents financial information, not investment advice.

**Is Tickview only for US markets?**

No. Prices cover stocks, ETFs, funds, crypto and commodities on many exchanges, shown in your own currency. Company financials and filings come from SEC EDGAR, so they cover companies that file with the SEC.

**Are the alerts and Recession Watch predictions?**

No. Recession Watch shows a model probability, the model estimate published by the New York Fed and calculated by Tickview from Treasury data, together with how often it has been right and its false alarms. Alerts are information, are checked when iOS allows and can arrive late. Neither is a prediction or a prompt to trade. The guides below cover the sources.

**Are the gain and loss figures tax figures?**

No. Values, gains and losses are estimates, calculated on your device from third-party prices and exchange rates and from the share counts and costs you typed. They are not a statement of any account and not figures for a tax return. Your broker's or provider's records are the record.

**Do widgets, Siri and Spotlight send my data anywhere?**

No. Widgets read a small copy of your watchlist's figures that Tickview keeps on the device. Answers through Siri and Shortcuts are worked out on the device; when you speak to Siri, Apple handles the voice request under its own privacy policy. The Spotlight index for your tickers and notes stays on the device.

**What does a share card show?**

Public figures with their source, the date of the data and the source's link. It never shows your share counts, position values or notes. A card is made on your device and leaves it only when you choose to share it.

### 11 Plus Exam Prep: Cognithix

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/cognithix/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760035436
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad
- Category: Education
- Price: 7-day free trial, then a one-time purchase
- Privacy: No account; data stays on the device.
- Privacy policy: https://bfgapps.co/apps/cognithix/privacy.html; support: https://bfgapps.co/apps/cognithix/support.html

11+ practice for ages 9 to 11: English, verbal reasoning, non-verbal reasoning and language aptitude (no maths), with daily plans, timed mock papers and parent progress insights.

Who it is for: Parents preparing a child for the 11+ for grammar and independent schools in England.

**Does it cover maths?**

No. Cognithix covers English, verbal reasoning, non-verbal reasoning and language aptitude. If your child's test includes maths, add a maths resource alongside it.

**Do I need an account?**

No. There's no sign-up. Profiles and progress are stored only on the device, behind a Parent PIN with a recovery code. Progress doesn't sync between devices.

**How does pricing work?**

Everything is free to try for 7 days. After that, one in-app purchase unlocks the full app for every child profile, with no subscription and no ads. Read an honest comparison with similar apps.

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/arithmetix/

- Category: Education
- Price: 7-day free trial, then a one-time purchase

UK National Curriculum maths from Reception to Year 6 with spaced repetition, times tables practice for the Year 4 multiplication check, and virtual pet motivation.

Who it is for: UK primary school children and their parents.

**Do I need an account?**

No. There's no sign-in, email or password. Child profiles, answers and progress stay on the device, and a Parent PIN protects settings and purchases.

**Does it help with times tables?**

Yes. Tables 2 to 12 have their own practice area with a heat map, Table Race and an MTC-style Ready Mode for Year 4.

**How does pricing work?**

Every feature is free for 7 days. After that, a single purchase unlocks the full app for all your child profiles. No subscription, no ads.

### Doodlebee: Coloring & Drawing

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/sparks-studios/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760515470
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad
- Category: Games
- Price: Free download; one purchase unlocks everything for the whole family
- Privacy: No ads, no accounts; nothing a child draws, writes or composes is uploaded.
- Privacy policy: https://bfgapps.co/apps/sparks-studios/privacy.html; support: https://bfgapps.co/apps/sparks-studios/support.html

Drawing and coloring app for kids and grown-ups: draw any shape, tap to fill it and watch it dance, with pages to color by hand or by number, storybooks read aloud and music.

Who it is for: Children and families who want a calm, safe creative app.

**Is it just for kids?**

No. Kids draw, fill, animate and make stories; grown-ups get their own profile with a calm corner for coloring and color by number, and a PIN that keeps children out of the settings.

**How does the coloring work?**

In Color In, kids color by hand inside the lines, with pinch-to-zoom for small details and stars for neat coloring. In Color by Number, you tap the numbered areas with the matching color, and finishing the picture reveals the original painting exactly, shading and all. There are 146 pages in all. On your own drawings, tap inside any shape to fill it.

**Is it safe for young children?**

Yes. There's no social sharing, no public gallery and no stranger interaction — a parental gate keeps purchases, sharing and settings out of little hands.

**Does it need an account or the internet?**

No. There's no sign-up, it works offline, and everything anyone creates stays on the device; grown-ups decide what gets shared. It runs on iPhone and iPad with iOS 26 or later, and the app is in English for now.

**What's the story helper?**

Creating is the point — drawing, filling, animating, coloring, storybooks and music come first. On supported devices, the unlock also adds an optional story helper: Sparky takes turns with a child on a story they started, and every reply is checked before a child sees it. See how on-device AI keeps that private.

### PhotoFlight: Travel Photo Map

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/photoflight/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761143528
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad, Mac
- Category: Travel
- Price: Free download; Pro is a one-time purchase
- Privacy: No account; your travel history stays on the device.
- Privacy policy: https://bfgapps.co/apps/photoflight/privacy.html; support: https://bfgapps.co/apps/photoflight/support.html

Travel map built from the location data already in your photos: countries, cities, flights and achievements, with no live tracking needed. Includes PhotoGuessr, a family game where everyone secretly pins where one of your photos was taken.

Who it is for: Travellers who want a map of past trips from the photos they already have.

**Do I need to start a new trip log?**

No. PhotoFlight works from the photos you already have, not just trips you start recording today.

**Where is PhotoGuessr?**

PhotoGuessr is now part of PhotoFlight rather than a separate app. Open the Passport tab and tap PhotoGuessr. It comes with PhotoFlight Pro and plays with your own photos, on your device.

**Does it upload my photos anywhere?**

No. Your photos are read on your device and your library is never uploaded. Apple's services may look up place names from photo locations and display maps.

**How does it compare to similar apps?**

Read an honest comparison with similar apps.

### Ondi: Private Period Tracker

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/cyla/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760896784
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad
- Category: Health & Fitness
- Price: Free version; 7-day trial of everything, then a one-time purchase
- Privacy: No accounts and no Ondi server; logs stay on the device.
- Privacy policy: https://bfgapps.co/apps/cyla/privacy.html; support: https://bfgapps.co/apps/cyla/support.html

Private period and cycle diary with Apple Watch temperature support.

Who it is for: People who want to keep a cycle diary without an account or an Ondi server.

**Is Ondi private?**

Yes. There is no account, no Ondi server and no tracking analytics. Your logs are stored on your device, and device backups follow Apple's rules. The only network request is an App Store lookup for the names and icons of our other apps; it carries no health data.

**What's free?**

Logging in every mode, your full history, the calendar, the next-period estimate and export of your own data. Everything is free for 7 days; then one purchase unlocks insights, Ask Ondi on supported devices, smart ring insights and the pregnancy, postpartum and post-menopause dashboards. No subscription.

**How does it compare to similar apps?**

Read an honest comparison with similar apps.

Hyperlocal weather: rain alerts, live radar, a forecast blended from many sources, air quality and 24 widgets.

Who it is for: Anyone who wants accurate rain timing and a weather app without a subscription.

**Does Cloudmesh have live radar?**

Yes. Live rain radar follows your selected city so you can watch rain approach. Premium adds a chart of the next hour of rain.

**Is Cloudmesh a subscription?**

No. It's free to download with a generous free tier and a 7-day trial. Premium is a one-time purchase, with no recurring fee.

### PaceGrid: GPS Running Tracker

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/pacegrid/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760843225
- Platforms: iPhone, Apple Watch
- Category: Health & Fitness
- Price: Free version; 7-day trial of everything, then a one-time purchase
- Privacy: No account; workouts stay on the device.
- Privacy policy: https://bfgapps.co/apps/pacegrid/privacy.html; support: https://bfgapps.co/apps/pacegrid/support.html

GPS run, ride, walk and hike tracker with Load Guard training-load alerts, smart ring sleep data and GPX/FIT export.

Who it is for: Runners, cyclists and hikers who want to keep their training data without a subscription.

**Does PaceGrid need a subscription?**

No. All features are free for 7 days, recording stays free afterwards, and a single purchase unlocks the rest. Read Running Apps Without a Subscription.

**Can it track from my Apple Watch?**

Yes. PaceGrid records GPS workouts directly from your wrist, so you can leave your phone behind. The Apple Watch app is part of the full unlock.

**How does Load Guard work?**

It compares your recent training load with your longer-term baseline and can alert you during workouts. Learn more in Training Load & Injury Prevention.

### Minua: Earn Screen Time

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/minua/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760611967
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad
- Category: Productivity
- Price: One-time purchase, no subscription
- Privacy: Fully on the device, no accounts.
- Privacy policy: https://bfgapps.co/apps/minua/privacy.html; support: https://bfgapps.co/apps/minua/support.html

Screen time you earn, for your child or for yourself: time in the apps you want more of unlocks the apps you want less of. Parent PIN mode for a child's device, Myself mode for adults.

Who it is for: Parents setting screen-time rules, and adults breaking their own scroll habit.

**Is Minua only for kids?**

No. At setup you choose My child or Myself. Parents use it on a child's iPhone or iPad; adults use it on their own phone to break the scroll habit.

**Does Minua spy on anyone?**

No. Minua has no accounts, no servers and no tracking. Your settings and your balance stay on the device.

**How does earning work?**

Time in the apps you want more of unlocks time in the apps you want less of, at a ratio you set from 1:1 to 12:1.

**Can my child switch Minua off?**

On a child's device in Family Sharing, you approve Minua with your Apple Account, so your child can't switch the permission off or delete Minua without you. Settings and purchases sit behind a parent PIN.

**Can I change my own rules?**

Yes. In Myself mode it's your phone and your rules: you can change them in Settings whenever you decide to. The PIN is optional.

**Do I need an account or a subscription?**

No account and no sign-up. Every feature is free for 7 days; after that, a single one-time purchase unlocks the full app. No subscription.

### Bellgrave — 3D Roguelike RPG

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/bellgrave/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761905396
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad, Mac
- Category: Games
- Price: Free download; a one-time purchase unlocks the full game
- Privacy: No ads, no account; progress stays on the device.
- Privacy policy: https://bfgapps.co/apps/bellgrave/privacy.html; support: https://bfgapps.co/apps/bellgrave/support.html

Dark 3D roguelike horde-survivor: draft an arsenal of up to four weapons, evolve them from boss treasure, dodge telegraphed attacks, face multi-phase bosses across cursed realms. Touch or game controller.

Who it is for: Action and roguelike fans who want a premium game with no ads or timers.

**Is there a subscription?**

No. Bellgrave is a one-time unlock with no subscription, no ads, no battle pass and no energy timers.

**How do weapon evolutions work?**

Draft another hunter's weapon, take it to level 8 and hold its paired passive. The next boss treasure chest evolves it.

**How does seed-share work?**

Share a seed code or QR and a friend gets the same starting setup, same hunter, realm and seed, then compare brag cards and outplay each other.

### Inkla: Handwriting Practice

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/penlicence/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761393693
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad
- Category: Education
- Price: 7-day free trial, then a one-time purchase
- Privacy: On the device, no accounts.
- Privacy policy: https://bfgapps.co/apps/penlicence/privacy.html; support: https://bfgapps.co/apps/penlicence/support.html

Handwriting practice for kids in 8 languages (English, French, German, Spanish, Romanian, Japanese hiragana, Chinese, Hindi): letter formation with feedback after every attempt, print and cursive, Word Explorer and Meaning Quiz.

Who it is for: Children learning to write and the adults teaching them.

**What age group is it for?**

Children from about age 4 learning their first letters, through confident writers of 8 and up working on words, sentences and joined cursive.

**Do we need an Apple Pencil?**

No. Finger practice works on iPhone and iPad. With an Apple Pencil on iPad, Inkla also reads pressure and shows it during practice; it is not part of the score.

**Is there a subscription?**

No. Try Inkla free for 7 days, then unlock it with a one-time in-app purchase. No subscription, no ads.

### Keystrike: Piano Sight Reading

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/keystrike/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6763947075
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad, Mac
- Category: Education
- Price: 3-day free trial, then a one-time purchase
- Privacy: No account, no ads, no tracking; progress and recordings stay on the device.
- Privacy policy: https://bfgapps.co/apps/keystrike/privacy.html; support: https://bfgapps.co/apps/keystrike/support.html

Piano lessons: graded course from Grade 0 to Grade 8, sight-reading, ear training, built-in pieces as engraved sheet music or falling notes, MIDI keyboard or on-screen piano, MIDI import.

Who it is for: Beginners, returning players and self-taught learners who want a structured path.

**Do I need a MIDI keyboard?**

No. Start with the on-screen piano, use a USB or Bluetooth MIDI keyboard for the most precise input, or play a real piano in acoustic mode through the microphone.

**How many grades are there?**

A Grade 0 foundation, then Grades 1 to 8, each ending with an exam-style check. The grades are Keystrike's own progression, not an external exam qualification.

**Is there an Android version?**

No. Keystrike is built for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

**Will my progress sync between devices?**

No. Keystrike is local-first, so progress, recordings and imported MIDI files stay on the device they were created on. You can back them up and export them.

**Can I use my own sheet music?**

You can't import PDFs. You can import MIDI files (.mid, .midi), and Keystrike turns them into playable sheet music automatically.

**Is it for children or adults?**

Both. The early grades are gentle enough for a focused eight-year-old; the later grades go deep enough for adults tackling advanced repertoire.

### Custoda: Expiry Tracker

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/custoda/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6787263003
- Platforms: iPhone
- Category: Food & Drink
- Price: Free version; 7-day trial of everything, then a one-time purchase
- Privacy: No account; data stays on the device, and barcode lookups send only the barcode number.
- Privacy policy: https://bfgapps.co/apps/custoda/privacy.html; support: https://bfgapps.co/apps/custoda/support.html

Pantry, expiry and allergen tracker: scan to track expiry dates, allergen and diet warnings that say "unverified" when data is missing, recipes ranked by what you have, a household shopping list and dinner vote via private iCloud invitations, replace-by dates for smoke alarms and first-aid kits.

Who it is for: Households that want to waste less food and stay safe with allergens.

**Do I need an account?**

No. Custoda works without sign-up. Your shelf, reminders and allergen and diet profile live on your iPhone. The optional household features use your own iCloud, and only when you turn them on.

**Can Custoda tell me a product is safe?**

No, and it never claims to. It flags ingredients on your avoid list when product information is available, and says "unverified" when data is missing or incomplete. Product data comes from open, community databases. Always check the packaging. Custoda is not medical advice.

**How does household sharing work?**

Invite family members with a private iCloud invitation. Everyone shares one shopping list and can suggest recipes and vote on dinner. Sharing food from your inventory is off by default: you choose which items to share and can stop at any time. Your allergen and diet profile is never shared.

**Does it track medicines and safety equipment too?**

Yes. Keep food and drink, medicines, toiletries and household supplies in one inventory, and save replace-by dates for smoke alarms, carbon-monoxide detectors, fire extinguishers and first-aid supplies.

**What does it cost?**

Try every feature for 7 days with up to 20 items. After the trial you can keep up to 5 items and 3 avoid-list entries free, and warnings for everything on your avoid list are always shown. A one-time purchase adds diets, unlimited items and avoid-list entries, expiry reminders, household sharing (shared list, shared pantry and dinner vote) and recipe sharing. There is no subscription.

**Which devices and languages?**

Custoda is built for iPhone. The app is available in English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese and Simplified Chinese, with light and dark themes that follow your device.

Right now. Fare Wars is out on the App Store for iPhone and iPad and is free to play.

- Platforms: iPhone, iPad
- Category: Games

Jetpack runner across a city of rooftops: outrun patrols, beat bosses, rescue your crew and build your own robot in the Workshop.

Who it is for: Endless-runner fans on iPhone and iPad.

**When can I play Zoombot?**

Right now. Zoombot is out on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.

**Is Zoombot free?**

Yes. The game is free to play. Optional purchases add an endless mode without bosses, a permanent coin doubler and coin packs, and every upgrade can be earned by playing.

**Are there ads?**

No. No ads, no energy timers, no tracking and no account.

**How do I control the robot?**

One thumb. Hold and drag to pick your lane, swipe up to jump and swipe down to slide. Your weapon fires on its own.

**What ends a run?**

Ten escapes. Every rogue machine that slips past you counts, and the tenth one ends the run.

**Where is my progress saved?**

On your device. Zoombot doesn't collect any data, and purchases are handled by Apple.

**Is it violent?**

No. It is robots against robots: the rogue machines pop into sparks and bolts, with no people to hurt and no blood.

**Which devices does it run on?**

iPhone and iPad.

## Coming soon

### Nitro Metro

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/nitrometro/
- Status: coming soon (not yet on the App Store)

Arcade street racing across ten world cities with police chases, power-ups and cars to build; race friends nearby or online. Touch or game controller. Coming soon to iPhone and iPad.

**When can I play Nitro Metro?**

Nitro Metro is coming soon to the App Store for iPhone and iPad. We'll link it here as soon as it's live.

**Is Nitro Metro free?**

Yes, it's free to play. The optional one-time purchases are Coin Stack, Double Coins, Neon Underglow, Premium Paint Finishes and the four World Tour continents. Every continent can also be unlocked with coins earned by racing, and every car and upgrade is earned by racing.

**Are there ads?**

No third-party ads. The billboards around the cities show posters for our own games; they can't be tapped and never interrupt a race. No tracking and no account.

**How do I drive?**

Swipe left or right to change lanes and fire the nitro to break away. In drag races you shift gears yourself.

**Can I use a game controller?**

Yes. A PS5 DualSense, DualShock 4, Xbox or MFi controller works in races and every menu, with rumble. Touch always works too.

**How do pink slips work?**

You stake one of your cars against a boss crew. Win and you take their ride.

**Can I play with friends?**

Yes. Nearby, one iPhone or iPad hosts and up to seven friends join over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, with no internet needed. Online, Game Center powers Quick Match and Race Friends. The host picks the race, the route and the weather, and whether AI drivers join in. There is no chat.

**Does it play offline?**

Yes. Nitro Metro plays offline and needs no account. Nearby races work without internet, and online races use Game Center.

**Where is my progress saved?**

On your device. Nitro Metro doesn't collect any data, and purchases are handled by Apple.

**Which devices does it run on?**

iPhone and iPad.

### Hollowstead

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/hollowstead/
- Status: coming soon (not yet on the App Store)

A farming and survival game with a story, in development. Coming soon to iPhone and iPad.

**When can I play Hollowstead?**

Hollowstead is in development and coming to the App Store for iPhone and iPad. We'll link it here as soon as it's live.

**Who are the Hollowed?**

The dead who got up again after the Blight. They test your fences at night, and later by day too. Defences, traps and lanterns keep them out.

**Can I just farm?**

Yes. Casual has no story: just the farm, the seasons and the people. Survival and Hardcore bring the full story and the Hollowed.

**What is the Callow Deep?**

An endless mine under the old town, with new floors on every visit, better ore the deeper you go, and the Lanternkeepers' pages to find. Every fifth floor has a quick way home.

**Are there ads or tracking?**

No. There are no ads and no tracking, and the whole game runs on your device.
